steps: Copy UXDuck 0.42.0 for aarch64 and check its SHA-256
Put back what was there if it is not running within 30 s
warnings: MAVLink pauses while the service restarts
unit:
[Unit]
Description=UXDuck companion

[Service]
User=uxduck
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/uxduck companion --config /etc/uxduck/companion.toml
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
